description: A statically OBJECT/ARRAY/MAP-typed value never coerces to text: || refuses on either side (empty inputs too), CONCAT/CONCAT_WS (reporting as CONCAT)/LISTAGG (DISTINCT and WITHIN GROUP forms) refuse in every position naming the declared types, and the whole scalar string family (UPPER/LOWER, measuring/trimming/padding, substring/regex, searching) refuses in every argument position - through conditionals, derived columns and producer functions. The bounds: a VARIANT is never rejected even holding an object, casting/TRY_CASTing to VARIANT re-opens the family (the OBJECT target of each stays refused), explicit conversions to text are legal for the PLAIN types (a STRUCTURED value has none - pinned beside its plain twin) and the converted value flows on, ordinary types still concatenate, path reads pass, SEARCH takes semi-structured data on purpose, and key positions stay open. Converted 1:1 from expressions/SemiStructuredTextArgumentTest (now retired).
